quest.title: Playing With Fire... Works
quest.description: Naganohara Fireworks seems to have come up with some new pyrotechnics...

dialogues.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
dialogues.text: Oh, if it isn't my little girl's new pal? You here to hang out with her again?

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Good, very good! Hahaha, my little girl's a real good tinkerer, she is, eh?

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Did you come looking for her today?

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Well, that's unfortunate! She said she was going to gather materials to make new fireworks, so she's out at the moment!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh. Then where is she?

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: What? Err, what did you say?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yoimiya! Where's she gone?

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Oh, uh... I'm actually not that sure. She might have mentioned it, but you know, I don't think I heard it that clearly with these ears of mine...

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Do you have something you need from her? Would you like to buy some fireworks?

choices.text: We were looking to hang out with Yoimiya...

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Ah. Well in that case, I don't think you're going to have any luck. You can never know when she'll be back when she goes out to tinker with her fireworks.

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: How about this, then? She did make and then leave some new fireworks here in the store before she went out. Why don't you take them and go out to play?

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Uh, where did I leave them... Around here, maybe?

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Oh it's fine, don't worry. We've got tons of stock here in the store. Just take it and go have fun. Don't worry about it!

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Besides, my little girl was looking for people to give these things a test run anyway. Since you're here, it might as well be you, eh?

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Just take them out for a spin, and tell me how things went once you're done!

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: And once Yoimiya gets back, I'll pass your message on to her.

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Don't worry about it. I'm sure she'll be more than happy to know that it was you who took them out for a whirl!

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Off you go, then. Make sure you set these off outside the city, though. If you light them up inside, you're going to attract a whole bunch of people...

choices.text: We'd like to have fun with some fireworks...

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Haha, I see, I see. That's good, then. Yoimiya did make and then leave some new fireworks here in the store before she went out. Why don't you take them and go out to play?

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Ah, you're here looking for her, eh?

talks.objective: Test the fireworks outside the city

dialogues.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
dialogues.text: Off you go, then. Make sure you set these off outside the city, though. If you light them up inside, you're going to attract a whole bunch of people...

dialogues.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back! How were the fireworks?

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Glad that you enjoyed them!

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Well, I need to get back to manning the store now. Business has really picked up recently.

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Heh, why isn't that girl back yet. Where has she gone to do her tinkering, I wonder...

response.speaker: Naganohara Ryuunosuke
response.text: Oh, you really liked it, didn't you? Don't worry. I'll pass you some more next time.
